mintAuthority.summary: XO Cash is authored only as a Solana M0 extension. M0 documents Solana as a hub-and-spoke representation reached by locking M on Ethereum and minting the corresponding Solana extension through the Portal; the authored XO deployment does not establish a separate native XO liability path. Portal, extension mint/burn, and program-upgrade controls are reviewed under Bridge Risk, while base M issuance remains assessed on m-m0.

review.evidence: Official M0 documentation describes Solana as a spoke with Ethereum as the hub: extensions are transferred by locking the source token on Ethereum, passing a Wormhole message, and minting an equivalent Solana extension through the Portal. Exodus identifies XO Cash as built on Solana with MoonPay and M0. The former Ethereum MinterGateway observation is parent M issuance assessed on m-m0, not a local XO mint authority; the Portal, XO mint PDA, and shared Solana upgrade-key observations are preserved in bridgeRouteRisk.controls[]. Queue convergence review 2026-10-03 re-read M0's cross-chain architecture: the Solana section still specifies HubPortal lock on Ethereum, Wormhole message, and Portal mint of the equivalent Solana extension. The reviewed external-only-representation exception covers the sole authored Solana deployment and no native XO mint control is authored, so adaptMintReview emits a known not-applicable mint review with null controlKey and no mint controls; the published posture is none-resolved. Annotate none-resolved-mint only for the absence of an independently authored native issuance surface. mintPath unknown, confidence unknown, the unresolved native-liability question, and all Bridge Risk powers remain unchanged. This does not assert fixed-unit pure-wrapper equivalence, close the unresolved source/executable correspondence of the extension program, or claim a new Solana observation; those uncertainties remain as recorded.
unresolvedQuestions: No separately authored canonical native XO-liability deployment has been identified outside the reviewed Solana M0 extension route.

noLocalIssuance.rationale: The only authored XO deployment is the Solana extension token; M0's official architecture identifies extension issuance as a lock-and-mint representation of the Ethereum hub asset, not an independently authored native XO issuance deployment.
